svg.title: ESP32 hardware wiring diagram — LCD direct I2C, pump via L293D
svg.desc: Wiring schematic. Soil sensor connects via RS485 A+/B- to MAX485, which connects via UART to ESP32. LCD 16x2 connects directly to ESP32 via I2C on GPIO 21/22. L293D IN1 connects to GPIO 32, OUT drives water pump. Power rails shown dashed.

g.text: USB 5 V → ESP32 · MAX485 · LCD · L293D Vcc1/EN1 · motor supply → L293D Vcc2
